mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Imagine stepping behind the velvet curtain of Hollywood’s golden age, where laughter echoes through grand ballrooms and vulnerability hides just beneath the surface. That’s the world we get to explore together in The Moon’s a Balloon, masterfully told by David Niven himself. You’ll find it’s not all glitz and glamour. This is a place where happiness can feel just out of reach, where the spotlight sometimes casts long shadows. As we journey from a privileged, yet emotionally tangled childhood, all the way to the bright lights of international stardom, we’ll see just how much resilience it takes to hold onto joy—and to keep moving forward, even when heartbreak calls your name. Through stories rich with wit, unlikely friendships, and quietly honest reflections, we get to share in both the laughter and the tears. You’ll meet legends, witness moments of self-doubt, and search for meaning right alongside David Niven as he invites us into his world—a world that’s both dazzling and deeply human. So, are you ready? Let’s set off together, and take a closer look at the joys and heartaches that shaped a truly unforgettable life.
